article.question: How should I compare a video compressed with Fast Cleaner?

source.title: Choose your backup quality
source.fact: Google uses this phrase for Storage saver backups. A backup setting or smaller file should not be assumed to preserve an identical original.

article.claim_scope: Official guidance supports platform facts. Fast Cleaner descriptions rely on its developer disclosures and existing store/product assets; no independent performance or security test is claimed.
